name: Human Missile 🚀💥
desc:
I am the weapon. I am the projectile. I am inevitable. 🚀

Strap in and launch yourself into total brick-based carnage! 💥 Why fire a missile when you can BE the missile? Smash through structures, rack up points, and upgrade your chaos.

HOW TO PLAY:
🚀 LAUNCH into the sky by holding the mouse button (PC), Holding boost button (Mobile) or Right trigger (Console)!
🎯 STEER into the biggest and most valuable targets by moving your camera!
💥 EXPLODE for maximum destruction by impacting at high speeds!
✨ UPGRADE your missile for more destruction!

This game is currently in BETA, more FEATURES/ITEMS will be added in time!
please report any bugs / recommend suggestions.
